◐ development evidence · out of fold, used to choose
Nothing here changes the study. Computed from saved predictions; no model is refitted.
The engine has not compared the models yet. The agent compares them in the chat.
: the observed value minus the predicted one; positive, the model predicted too low
A mean residual near zero in every group means the model errs in both directions as often; a group far from zero is predicted too high or too low as a whole.
A mean residual near zero does not mean small errors: errors in both directions cancel out. Read it with the mean absolute error of the group.
Where the residuals lean, the model leans.
